data.one_liner: Provides country dialing codes and a picker widget with SVG flags.
data.what_it_does: This package offers a list of 250 country dialing codes and names, and includes a customizable picker widget that displays flags and allows selection via a modal bottom sheet. It also supports searching and ranking of countries in the picker.
use_when: You need to display or retrieve a country dialing code by ISO 3166 code.
You want a ready‑made country picker with flags for user input.
You need SVG flag images for high‑quality display.
avoid_when: You only need a simple map of codes and prefer a lightweight data‑only solution.
You are building a non‑Flutter project or a pure Dart backend.
You require advanced localization or internationalization beyond dialing codes.
strengths: Built‑in picker widget with customizable layout and callbacks.
SVG flag support for crisp rendering on all platforms.
weaknesses: Limited to Flutter; not usable in pure Dart projects.
No support for custom country data beyond the provided list.
